note: Real. NASA FIRMS MODIS C6.1 and VIIRS S-NPP daily counts (brady/brazil-data). AI-generated analysis (Claude); team review required before any slide. fixed = Aqua count before 2012 (Aqua's clock had not drifted), then S-NPP count x the 2012-2020 Aqua/S-NPP ratio for that calendar month, in Aqua units; lo/hi from the block bootstrap of that ratio; S-NPP outage days filled with NOAA-20 x 1.050. outage flag = 3 or more S-NPP outage days in the month. median_ref = median fixed count for that calendar month, 2002-2025.
